$comment: Where each mob model comes from; see tools/make-models.mjs. Draft new entries with tools/models/discover.mjs.

$resourcePacks.$why: Soulrend loads Excalibur over vanilla (config/paxi/resourcepack_load_order.json); it only retextures
G's ReDraco is the last pack Soulrend loads over the dragons (after Excalibur's Ice and Fire pack); used on the dragons only

$attacks.$comment: The Epic Fight attack viewer in {{moveset}} embeds: npm run attacks builds it, npm run skin -- <png> swaps the player's skin. See tools/make-attacks.mjs.
$attacks.$skin: slim (Alex) arms are detected from the skin's transparent arm columns; set "slim": true or false to override

dummy.$why: MmmMmmMmmMmm's target dummy, as DummmmmmyClient registers its body layer (createMesh(0, 64)); size from its EntityType (sized(0.6, 2)). The hit wobble is its own prepareMobModel/setupAnim, driven by TargetDummyEntity's shake for a hit of `damage` (an iron sword's 7, as a stand-in) at the client config's animation_intensity

horse.$why: Mounted attacks ride a saddled brown horse (HorseModel.setupAnim with a saddled, ridden horse). rider: the player's feet above the ground, Entity.getPassengersRidingOffset (0.75 × the horse's 1.6 height) plus Player.getMyRidingOffset (-0.35). A mounted attack moves only the joints of Epic Fight's upper_joints mask; the rest keep the riding pose (Animations.BIPED_MOUNT)

$attacks.$clearance: how far (blocks) a dummy stands at least from the player, so the two models don't overlap; attacks that reach no further get dummies just past the player's hitbox
$attacks.$everyItem: true builds every weapon's own model (about 1,300 files, 19 MB) so item pages show that weapon; false keeps one per weapon type
$attacks.$items: weapon type → the item held in its viewer, when the automatic pick (the type's own mod first, then vanilla, then the rest, skipping items drawn by code) isn't the best one

iceandfire:black_frost_dragon.$why: not a registered entity; Ice and Fire ships its texture for the ice dragon model

iceandfire:dread_queen.$why: not a registered entity; the model and texture are in the jar

iceandfire:fire_dragon.$why: RenderDragonBase draws every color, stage and gender with the same model and picks the texture by color and stage (getVariantName + getDragonStage), drawing male_<color>.png over it for males; this is a red stage 5 female, "variants" the others

iceandfire:hydra.$why: LayerHydraHead draws a ModelHydraHead per head from BodyUpper, moved by TRANSLATE and turned by ROTATE (row for 3 heads, the spawn count)

iceandfire:ice_dragon.$why: RenderDragonBase draws every color, stage and gender with the same model and picks the texture by color and stage (getVariantName + getDragonStage), drawing male_<color>.png over it for males; this is a blue stage 5 female, "variants" the others

iceandfire:lightning_dragon.$why: RenderDragonBase draws every color, stage and gender with the same model and picks the texture by color and stage (getVariantName + getDragonStage), drawing male_<color>.png over it for males; this is a electric stage 5 female, "variants" the others

minecraft:ender_dragon.$why: EnderDragonRenderer.DragonModel.renderToBuffer draws neck 5 times, then the head, then neck 12 times as the tail; the leg and wing angles are its values at rest
